name: NeuraKeep
description: Stores source-cited agent memory with review-gated updates and failure history; exposes search/read/propose tools over local stdio MCP and a CLI, plus an OAuth-gated hosted MCP endpoint.

skills.name: Memory Search
skills.description: Searches stored memory for relevant entries through the memory_search tool, over stdio MCP or the local HTTP server.

skills.name: Memory Read
skills.description: Reads a stored memory entry in full with the memory_read tool, returning its recorded content to the agent.

skills.name: Explain Memory Sources
skills.description: Returns the sources behind a memory entry via memory_explain_sources, so an agent can check where a stored claim came from.

skills.name: Propose Memory Update
skills.description: Submits a proposed change to stored memory with memory_propose_update, queuing it for review instead of writing directly.

skills.name: Apply Memory Update
skills.description: Commits a reviewed memory proposal with memory_apply_update, completing the review-gated write path.
